reason: r5 does what clarkekoko's "Lock-on Target MHGU Recomp" and "No Target Reticle" cheats do with two Forge hooks that replace their function: the tap logic 0x27e970 for the local hunter (a tap toggles the lock; while on, only the single-tap target request, bit 0, is raised every frame, never bit 24) and the reticle check 0x190d4, which returns 0 so the reticle is never drawn. r4's code patches were ignored by MHGURecomp.
runtime_test: r5 has not run. r4 ran on MHGURecomp and did nothing: all five code patches were logged as "cannot apply to recompiled code: ignored" (EVIDENCE.json runtime_r4_recomp_2026_11_24). The user ran the cheat itself and found it better than r2: "didnt ruin aiming". r2 was accepted on Eden and MHGURecomp 0.14.3.
